messages:
jana: opened PR to add Terra-6B (int8 Q4) to the model catalog + model card (limits, migration notes, SDK snippets). PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5321
owen: nice — can you paste the bench numbers/hardware for the limits table?
kevin: quick summary: a100-80g (1x), p50 ~28ms @256 tokens (batch=4), sustained ~210 tok/s (batch=12), resident ~20GB with int8 (Q4). full csv: https://gist.github.com/kevin/terra6b
sam: link-checker flagged a relative link in the migration guide: `../models/terra` -> 404
link-bot: Link check failed: /docs/models/terra -> 404
jana: will switch to `/models/terra` canonical slug and add a redirect for old permalinks. also adding a "Runtime compatibility" row.
kevin: note: Terra-6B-int8 uses KV cache layout v2; runtimes <3.1 cannot load the int8 artifact and will auto-fallback to terra-6b-fp16. please add explicit wording.
sam: also add a short bullet under "known diffs" about small tokenization/output variance when toggling fp16 <-> int8 (~2-5%). saves future support tickets.
kevin: limits table nit: `max sequence: 8192 (tested); recommended sustained <=4096 for stable P50` and replace generic "quantized" wording with "int8 (Q4)" everywhere.
jana: adding Python + JS snippets (embeddings, batched) for the PR. dropping them here for copy/paste:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient()
resp = c.embeddings.create(model='terra-6b-int8', input=['a','b','c'], batch_size=8)
print([d.embedding for d in resp.data])
```
```javascript
import Redwood from '@redwoodai/sdk'
const client = new Redwood()
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'terra-6b-int8', input: ['a','b','c'], batchSize: 8 })
console.log(resp.data.map(d => d.embedding.length))
```
docs-bot: PR updated — running checks (link-check, lint, build)
staging-bot: docs build passed — staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/models/terra (expires in 48h)
jana: thanks all. will merge after sam's approval and post a short note in #release-war-room once live.
